title: It Still Works
tagline: Life is full of things we feel but never say.

scenes.vo: My father's phone screen has been cracked for three years. Every time I ask him to change it, he says, "It still works." That was never the reason.
He types slowly now, his thumb skipping the broken corner.
Last month, I saw him at a phone shop. He picked up a new one, checked the price… and put it back.
That same week, my college fees were paid. On time. Like always. He never told me how.
Fathers like him don't say, "I love you." They say, "Have you eaten?" "Message me when you reach." "It still works." Different words. Same meaning.

scenes.vo: So this time, I didn't ask. I saved for four months. I left a new phone on his table, with a note: "Now it's my turn, Papa."
